Iguana vendored frontend assets v22

Runtime copies are committed into spring-panel/src/main/resources/static/vendor
so the panel no longer needs public CDNs for its core frontend runtime.

Packages:
- Bootstrap 5.3.0 and 5.3.3 — MIT
- Bootstrap Icons 1.10.0 and 1.10.5 — MIT
- Select2 4.1.0-rc.0 — MIT
- Flatpickr 4.6.13 — MIT
- Chart.js 4.5.1 — MIT
- jQuery 3.6.0 — MIT
- Lottie Web 5.12.2 — MIT

The package version is encoded in each vendor directory.
Keep upgrades explicit and reviewable rather than switching back to unpinned CDN URLs.
